d:
The historic SS United States has made its final voyage. The iconic ocean liner sank off Florida's coast on November 11, in a carefully planned operation to transform it into an artificial reef. Okaloosa County says the vessel will become the world's largest artificial reef. Its environmentally unsafe materials were removed before the sinking, paving the way for marine life to inhabit the ship.
